I wanted to do a lil follow-up on the test capital I put into the @AxisFDN Origin Vault last month to test the deposit flow and see how the vault handled the position.

TL;DR: The 30-day lock ends this Friday, September 4, at 14:00 UTC, along with the Season 0 pre-deposit boost.

That means depositors can leave their position in the vault, redeem their ogUSDx into USDx, or move into another Season 1 position.

So here are the different options I'm considering:

→ Keep it in the Ecosystem Vault

This is the simplest option IMO because the vault moves to a flat 10x multiplier for Season 1 and is still the most hands-off way to stay in the ecosystem.

→ Redeem my $USDx

If I decide to take it out of the vault, I can either redeem for free over 7 days and keep earning Coordinates while it processes, or redeem instantly for roughly a 30 bps fee.

→ Hold $USDx

If I withdraw from the vault but want a higher multiplier without using an LP or Pendle position, holding USDx earns 16x Coordinates.

→ Use Axis’s market access to @CurveFinance

Providing liquidity in the $USDx / $USDT pool earns 20x Coordinates. I could provide liquidity rather than just hold $USDx, so there is a little more to consider.

→ Use Axis’s market access to @pendle_fi

Providing liquidity in the USDx Pendle market also earns 20x Coordinates.

Alternatively, YT-USDx earns the highest multiplier at 24x. It is also the highest-risk option because Pendle YT decays toward maturity and can go to zero.

Coordinates accrue daily based on your position and its multiplier. The same dollar only counts once, so multipliers don't stack.

So if you’re like me and deposited a small amount to test the vault, it’s worth reviewing the full Season 1 table before automatically swapping your USDx back into USDT.

Btw, you can find their full transparency dashboard here: https://t.co/y7WZTnpwez

What's your plan on this?

#Uranium #Silver #Copper #Gold

📊 DAILY METALS PULSE

The dollar blinked, and metals moved.

🥇 Gold is up 1.1% near $4,435 as the dollar and Treasury yields ease.

🥈 Silver is back above $66, gaining 1.2%. Weak private-payroll growth is helping, but Friday’s US jobs report will decide whether this rebound has real legs.

🟠 Copper holds near $6.50/lb after recently challenging record highs. The interesting part remains the geographic squeeze: huge inventories have accumulated in the US while available LME stocks have fallen to just 90,000 tonnes. Plenty of copper on paper, but increasingly in the wrong place.

That is not energy independence. It is a reminder of how much new uranium supply must still be developed.

Precious metals are trading the Fed today. Copper and uranium are trading increasingly visible supply constraints.

Four metals. Different catalysts. The same underlying theme: supply and confidence are both becoming harder to find.

tweets.text:
none of these people have any kind of plan for how this would actually be effectuated 

who counts as relevant? what radius? when's the cutoff? how long to the payments run for? what defines worth? do people closer by get paid more? is the payout proportional to the nuisance? do people near DCs with onsite generation get paid more? do you get paid if you buy a house _after_ the DC is installed? do you get paid if it was an industrial site before, and that expectation was fully baked even before you bought the house? 

if the norm becomes "anyone within a 10k radius of a 250MW datacenter gets paid" people will start squatting on property or buying up land parcels nearby. it will have endless unintended and perverse consequences. 

in reality, the locals get paid already. 
- their land value likely went up, and they often have the opportunity to sell it at a massive markup to the developer 
- the DCs pay a half dozen taxes that fund city county and state, directly paying from all the services residents use 
- the residents get to file frivolous lawsuits complaining about noise which the developer will probably settle for nonzero

Where you go in life will depend on how you see things and who and what you feel connected to (your family, your community, your country, mankind, the whole ecosystem, everything). You will have to decide to what extent you will put the interests of others above your own, and which others you will choose to do so for. 

That's because you will regularly encounter situations that will force you to make such choices. #principleoftheday
